Schnittstelle Maybe<A>

Typparameter:
A - the contained value type
Alle Superschnittstellen:
Appliable<Maybe.µ,A>, Bindable<Maybe.µ,A>, Copyable<Maybe<A>>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher1<Maybe.µ,A>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Hkt<Maybe.µ>, Mappable<Maybe.µ,A>, Monadic<Maybe.µ,A>, Supplier<A>, Transmogrifyable<Maybe<A>>, Unwindable<Maybe<A>>, Value<A>
Alle bekannten Implementierungsklassen:
Maybe.None, Maybe.Some
public sealed interface Maybe<A> extends Monadic<Maybe.µ,A>, Copyable<Maybe<A>>, Unwindable<Maybe<A>>, Transmogrifyable<Maybe<A>>, Value<A>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher1<Maybe.µ,A> permits Maybe.Some<A>, Maybe.None<A>

A lightweight optional container: either there is a typed value, or there isn't. Laziness is preserved for the contained value via Supplier-based Some where applicable.

Evaluation semantics:

  • The presence of a value (Some vs None) is decided eagerly at construction time or when using monadic operations such as flatMap(Function).
  • The payload of Some is represented lazily and is only evaluated when methods like get(), map(Function), flatMap(Function) (on the inner value), unwind(), Object.equals(Object), Object.hashCode(), or Object.toString() are invoked.

Contract: unless stated otherwise, inputs must not be null and results must not be null.

    • ifSome

      default Maybe<A> ifSome(@NonNull Runnable runnable)

      Executes the given action if a value is present. This is a convenience overload of ifSome(Consumer) for cases where the action does not need access to the contained value.

      Laziness: The decision whether to run the action is made eagerly based on whether this Maybe is Some. The payload is not evaluated unless other operations (e.g. get()) are invoked.

      Parameter:
      runnable - the action to run when this is Some; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      this Maybe
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • ifNone

      default Maybe<A> ifNone(@NonNull Supplier<A> supplier)

      Returns this Maybe if a value is present; otherwise supplies a fallback value. If this is None, the supplied value is wrapped in Some and returned. A NullPointerException is thrown if the supplier is null or supplies null.

      Laziness: The supplier is only invoked eagerly when this Maybe is None. The fallback value itself is stored lazily inside Some according to the usual payload semantics.

      Parameter:
      supplier - supplies a fallback value when this is None; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      this if Some, otherwise a new Some with the supplied value
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • ifNone

      default Maybe<A> ifNone(@NonNull Runnable runnable)

      Executes the given action if this Maybe is empty. This is useful for triggering side effects (logging, metrics, fallbacks) when no value is present, without changing the Maybe itself.

      Laziness: No payload is evaluated, as None carries no value. The runnable is invoked eagerly if and only if this is None.

      Parameter:
      runnable - the action to run when this is None; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      this Maybe
      Seit:

    • filter

      @UnwindingOperation default @NonNull Maybe<A> filter(@NonNull Predicate<? super A> predicate)

      Filters the contained value using the given predicate. If a value is present and the predicate evaluates to true, this Maybe is returned unchanged; otherwise None is returned.

      Laziness:

      • The decision whether the result is Some or None is made eagerly when filter is invoked, based on evaluating the predicate on the current payload.
      • If the result is Some, the payload may still be lazy according to the original Some implementation.

      Parameter:
      predicate - the predicate to test the value; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a filtered Maybe
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • zip

      default <B,C> @NonNull Maybe<C> zip(@NonNull Maybe<B> other, @NonNull BiFunction<A,B,C> zipper)

      Zips this Maybe with another using the given zipper. If either side is None, the result is None.

      Laziness:

      • The decision whether the result is Some or None is made eagerly when zip is invoked, based on the presence of values in both operands.
      • When both operands are Some, their payloads are evaluated eagerly in order to compute the combined value via zipper.
      • The combined value is then stored according to the usual Some payload semantics, which may still be lazy depending on how some is used.

      Typparameter:
      B - the other value type
      C - the result type
      Parameter:
      other - the other Maybe; must not be null
      zipper - the combining function; must not be null and must not return null
      Gibt zurück:
      a Maybe of the combined value
      Seit:
      1.0.0
